#2389. Le pagelle di Napoli-Lazio 1-1: Frattesi torna al gol, Mandas salva tutto, male Floriani Mussolini

Le valutazioni dei calciatori biancocelesti in occasione della sfida in trasferta contro il Napoli

Secondo pari stagionale per la Lazio, che nel lunch match domenicale delle ore 12:30 ha fatto visita al Napoli. I partenopei interrompono la striscia di sei vittorie consecutive della formazione di Gattuso con una prestazione che si accende principalmente nel secondo tempo, mentre nella prima frazione è la Lazio ad avere la partita in mano, portandosi in vantaggio con la rete di Frattesi, a cui risponde nella ripresa la sfortunata autorete di Pedraza. Dopo Zaccagni, la Lazio perde Sutalo, fino a quel momento un pilastro della difesa laziale, e Tavares, già acciaccato in settimana. Due infortuni che cambiano il volto di una partita che lascia anche qualche rammarico. La Lazio però si tiene stretto il punto conquistato e va alla sosta ancora prima in classifica. Tutti i voti dei calciatori biancocelesti contro il Napoli.

CLICCA QUI E SEGUI LAZIOPRESS.IT ANCHE SU INSTAGRAM

Colpevole, insieme a Provstgaard, di un passaggio nel primo tempo che poteva rivelarsi fatale. Si riscatta nel corso della gara: in particolare, ferma il tentativo di Houjlund sulla linea di porta con una mano. Un intervento che vale quanto un gol. Nel complesso ottimi firma diverse chiusure decisive che salvano la Lazio

Non prende mai Lang e viene spesso anticipato. Lento, impreciso e autore di troppi errori. Prestazione da dimenticare: si perde ancora l'olandese sul cross che ha portato al gol dei padroni di casa. Dal 60' Lazzari - 6 Più attento del compagno che rileva, bravo a contenere Lang che fino a quel momento aveva dominato quella fascia.

Prestazione brillante, bene in marcatura su Hojlund e sempre pronto a leggere i pericoli creati dal Napoli. Sfiora anche il gol di testa nel primo tempo, poi parato da Milinkovic-Savic. Peccato per l'infortunio. Dal 32' Diogo Leite 6 - Gara attenta e pulita la sua. La squadra dal suo ingresso però va in difficoltà in uscita palla, da centrale destro, mancino di piede, fatica in fase di impostazione.

Più goffo in marcatura del solito nel primo tempo. Nella ripresa è bravo soprattutto sui palloni aerei.

Acciaccato, ma sveglio sulla fascia. In coppia con Noslin dialoga bene e rispetto alla gara contro il Cagliari, dà quel guizzo in più, che si spegne nel secondo tempo con la sua uscita. Non al 100% e per questo viene sostituito. Dal 45' Pedraza 5 - È sfortunato e devia in porta il gol che porta il Napoli sul pari.

Trova il gol del vantaggio, grazie alla palla perfetta di Noslin. Firma il quarto gol stagionale, ma la prestazione resta condizionata da diverse scelte sbagliate e troppo imprecise. Dal 77' Cancellieri - sv.

Provvidenziale il suo intervento con Mandas fuori dai pali: evita al Napoli di siglare il 2-1. Una giocata che vale quanto un gol. Nel complesso prestazione ordinata, anche se condita con qualche imprecisione.

Poco cercato e raramente coinvolto nella manovra. Fatica a entrare nel vivo del gioco, ben contenuto dalla difesa napoletana.

Buona prova di leadership, indossa la fascia da capitano tenendo bene la corsia. Quando vede il Napoli si accende, anche se, come nel caso di Taylor viene coinvolto meno, condizionato anche dalla prestazione negativa di Floriani. Cala nel secondo tempo.

Dialoga bene con i compagni e prova a fare reparto da solo, ma nella ripresa cala e Gattuso preferisce sostituirlo. Dal 60' Dele-Bashiru 6 - Mette in campo la fisicità che mancava alla Lazio in campo, più occupato in copertura che in fase offensiva.

Fa decisamente la differenza sulle fasce e firma anche il quarto assist stagionale. Come il resto della squadra finisce per spegnersi nella ripresa.

La Lazio domina il primo tempo e rischia di chiudere con più di un gol di scarto. Nella ripresa, complici gli infortuni di Sutalo e Tavares, il calo è evidente, ma portare un punto a casa su un campo così difficile non è mai scontato.

#2388. Viré dans les prochaines heures ? L'aventure en Premier League de Pierre Sage tourne au cauchemar

Pierre Sage vit très probablement ses dernières heures sur le banc de Crystal Palace en ce début de trêve internationale de novembre 2026. Arrivé l'été dernier, le technicien français est sur le point d'être démis de ses fonctions après un début de saison catastrophique en Premier League.

Dimanche 8 novembre 2026, Crystal Palace a concédé un nouveau revers à domicile lors de la 10e journée de Premier League en s'inclinant face à Liverpool (1-3) à Selhurst Park. Menés après des buts signés Alexis Mac Allister (40e), Florian Wirtz (54e) et Alexander Isak (89e), les Londoniens ont réagi trop tard grâce à un penalty transformé par Eddie Nketiah (90e+5). Cette défaite face aux Reds constitue le septième revers en dix journées de championnat pour Crystal Palace, qui n'a remporté que deux matches depuis le début de saison. Une situation critique. Le club londonien glisse ainsi à la 20e et dernière place du classement et se retrouve lanterne rouge pour la première fois depuis près de neuf ans, en décembre 2017.

La direction de Crystal Palace aurait déjà acté la décision de limoger Pierre Sage... et cela avant même la rencontre de dimanche soir. Interrogé sur son avenir, l'entraîneur français a livré son analyse en conférence de presse d'après-match :

Pierre Sage avait signé à Crystal Palace à la mi-juin 2026 pour un contrat de trois ans en provenance du RC Lens afin de remplacer Oliver Glasner. Le bilan global du technicien français à la tête des Eagles s'avère toutefois bien insuffisant, avec 5 victoires, 3 nuls et 8 défaites en 16 matches disputés toutes compétitions confondues. En championnat, le constat comptable est particulièrement alarmant. Crystal Palace possède en effet la plus mauvaise défense de Premier League, avec un total de 24 buts concédés en dix rencontres seulement. Un secteur défensif aux abois.

D'ailleurs, l'alerte avait déjà été donnée en interne en octobre, après des défaites à Lyon et surtout une déroute à Brighton (0-5). Au-delà des simples résultats sportifs, le board du club reproche à Pierre Sage l'absence d'évolution du jeu ainsi que des erreurs répétées au fil des semaines. À cela s'ajoutent des crispations palpables dans le vestiaire londonien, alimentées notamment par les mises à l'écart notables de Canvot et d'Axel Disasi.

Face à cette impasse sportive, les décideurs londoniens s'activent pour trouver un successeur sur le banc. Le Danois Thomas Frank, ancien entraîneur de Brentford et libre depuis son éviction de Tottenham en février dernier, apparaît désormais comme le grand favori pour succéder à Pierre Sage, d'après les informations de RMC Sport. Un technicien reconnu en Angleterre pour relancer la machine londonienne.

Toutefois, d'autres profils sont également cités par Sky Sports pour s'installer sur le banc de Crystal Palace. Parmi les pistes envisagées figurent notamment Frank Lampard, Sean Dyche, Vitor Pereira, Kim Hellberg, Vitor Matos et Tony Popovic. Le calendrier impose en tout cas une réaction rapide pour le club de Selhurst Park, dont le prochain match en Premier League est fixé au samedi 21 novembre 2026 sur le terrain de Coventry City.

#2386. « Je suis candidat à l'élection présidentielle de 2027 » : L'annonce inattendue de Teddy Riner !

C'est une annonce pour le moins inattendue dans le monde du sport tricolore. Ce lundi 9 novembre 2026, Teddy Riner a officialisé sa candidature à l'élection présidentielle de 2027 dans une vidéo publiée sur son compte X, tout en lançant son propre mouvement politique intitulé « La France qu'on veut ».

Le judoka français de 37 ans se lance ainsi en politique après avoir dominé le judo international. Quintuple champion olympique et onze fois champion du monde, Teddy Riner a bâti un palmarès exceptionnel qui le place au sommet de sa discipline. Alors que son avenir sportif restait au cœur des discussions depuis les Jeux de Paris, le Français surprend en ouvrant un tout autre chapitre personnel. Un virage spectaculaire.

Dans une vidéo publiée ce lundi 9 novembre 2026 sur son compte X, Teddy Riner a pris la parole face caméra afin de lever le voile sur ses intentions pour la prochaine présidentielle. Le judoka de 37 ans a officialisé sa démarche avec des mots simples et directs.

Conscient des réactions que son entrée en politique peut susciter, le quintuple champion olympique a tenu à devancer immédiatement les critiques concernant son manque d'expérience dans les fonctions publiques. Teddy Riner a ainsi déclaré : « Je sais ce qu'on va dire de moi. Il est fou, il n'est pas du sérail, il n'a pas les codes, il n'a jamais fait de politique. Mais posez-vous la question avec moi, qu'est-ce qui est fou aujourd'hui ? Je n'ai pas passé ma vie derrière un public, mais le combat a toujours fait partie de moi. » Une détermination affichée.

Pour concrétiser ses ambitions, le judoka français de 37 ans a également fondé sa propre formation politique ce lundi 9 novembre 2026, baptisée « La France qu'on veut ». Cette prise de parole sur les réseaux sociaux a d'ailleurs été accompagnée d'un entretien accordé au quotidien Le Parisien pour préciser le sens de sa démarche. Dans cet échange, Teddy Riner revendique une volonté de rassemblement sans affiliation partisane, affirmant vouloir devenir un « président qui fédère » sans se situer à droite ou à gauche.

En effet, le champion tricolore a expliqué que sa décision avait mûri dans le sillage direct de l'élan collectif suscité par les Jeux olympiques de Paris 2024. Porté par cette dynamique populaire, il entend désormais transposer cette ferveur sur le plan politique. Ainsi, son mouvement politique refuse d'entrer dans les clivages traditionnels pour privilégier une adhésion commune à l'échelle du pays. Un projet ambitieux.

Toutefois, cette ambition politique ne pousse pas Teddy Riner vers la retraite sportive. Sur le plan des compétitions, sa dernière apparition individuelle remonte aux Jeux olympiques de Paris en août 2024, suivie d'une participation sous les couleurs du PSG Judo en Ligue des champions en décembre 2024. Malgré cette nouvelle démarche politique, le quintuple champion olympique et onze fois champion du monde de judo demeure bel et bien un athlète en activité.

Au-delà de l'élection présidentielle de 2027, Teddy Riner a ainsi fait part de son souhait de participer aux Jeux olympiques de Los Angeles 2028 si ses futures responsabilités et les Français le lui permettent. Le judoka français lie donc son avenir sportif à la suite de son engagement public, avec en ligne de mire les Jeux olympiques de Los Angeles 2028.

#2385. Mamadou Coulibaly (AS Monaco) s'excuse après son geste polémique

Auteur de son premier but dans l'élite lors du match nul sur le terrain sarthois, Mamadou Coulibaly a suscité une vive polémique en mimant un geste d'égorgement. Le jeune milieu de l'AS Monaco se retrouve désormais sous la menace directe d'une lourde suspension.

Dimanche 8 novembre 2026, l'AS Monaco a été accrochée sur la pelouse du Mans FC (1-1) pour le compte de la 10e journée de Ligue 1. Si le club du Rocher espérait engranger des points précieux, la rencontre a été marquée par le geste de son joueur de 22 ans.

Titularisé dans l'entrejeu monégasque, Mamadou Coulibaly pensait passer une bonne soirée après avoir ouvert le score à la 40e minute de jeu. Mais la joie d'inscrire son tout premier but en Ligue 1 a rapidement viré au malaise lors de sa célébration. Le milieu monégasque s'est en effet dirigé vers le poteau de corner pour glisser sur les genoux, avant de tirer la langue et de mimer un geste d'égorgement avec son pouce sous la gorge. Un geste polémique.

Ce geste n'est malheureusement pas inédit en Principauté cette saison. En effet, cette célébration reproduit à l'identique celle effectuée par son partenaire de club Paris Brunner face à Strasbourg en septembre dernier, lors de la 4e journée de Ligue 1. Pour ce geste, le jeune attaquant avait été sanctionné par la commission de discipline de la LFP de quatre matches de suspension, dont deux fermes et deux avec sursis.

D'ailleurs, cette récidive au sein du même effectif met le joueur dans une situation extrêmement délicate. En raison de ce précédent disciplinaire très récent, Mamadou Coulibaly risque une sanction similaire d'au moins deux matches de suspension ferme devant la commission de discipline de la LFP. L'instance disciplinaire devrait se saisir rapidement du dossier pour trancher sur ce comportement. Un coup dur en perspective.

Conscient des remous provoqués par son geste, le joueur de 22 ans s'est exprimé devant les journalistes à l'issue de la rencontre. « Je tiens à m’excuser parce que j’ai cru comprendre que ça avait été mal compris. C’est un geste que j’ai fait par rapport un ami à moi qui m’a conseillé au sujet de la célébration. Je tiens à m'excuser si ça a pu heurter des gens. Maintenant, ce sont des choses qui se font dans d'autres championnats, je n'ai pas pensé que ça pourrait avoir des conséquences négatives », a ainsi déclaré Mamadou Coulibaly en zone mixte au micro des médias après Le Mans-Monaco.

Toutefois, cette justification risque de ne pas suffire auprès de son entraîneur Filipe Luis. Le coach monégasque avait pourtant publiquement averti son groupe en septembre après l'affaire similaire, insistant sur l'exemplarité attendue : « Il a fait une erreur. Il l'a compris tout de suite. Il s'est excusé. Le club prend cette affaire très au sérieux (…). On espère que ça ne se reproduira plus », avait prévenu le technicien en conférence de presse. Au-delà de cette polémique extra-sportive, l'AS Monaco accueillera l'AJ Auxerre au stade Louis-II le samedi 21 novembre 2026 à 20h45 pour la 11e journée de Ligue 1.

#2384. Bundesliga Team of the Week – Matchday 9

With Matchday 9 of the 2026/27 Bundesliga season in the books, Bulinews Editor-in-Chief Rune Gjerulff has selected his Team of the Week, which lines up in a 4-3-3 formation.

1. FC Köln may have lost 1-2 to local rivals Bayer Leverkusen, but Schwäbe certainly did his best to help his side take something from the game, making six saves and preventing 2.59 expected goals.

Making his return from an injury-enforced absence, Coufal impressed by winning all of his duels while also making valuable contributions going forward.

Another impressive outing from the French centre-back, who won eight duels and was excellent in possession, finding a teammate with 94 percent of his 84 passes.

A rock-solid performance from the centre-back, who won 10 of his 11 duels while also completing 88 percent of his passes.

Impressed at both ends of the pitch, winning 10 duels and scoring the winner in Stuttgart's 1-0 victory over Werder Bremen.

Named Man of the Match in Bayern's 2-1 win over Mainz, Kimmich opened the scoring and pulled the strings in midfield as usual. He completed 93 percent of his 98 passes while also winning six of his seven ground duels.

Leverkusen's midfield talisman scored a wonderful free-kick and completed 93 percent of his passes, while also winning six of his seven duels.

The difference-maker for Borussia Dortmund, Nmecha scored twice to inspire his side to a 2-1 victory over SV Elversberg.

Grønbæk made a decisive contribution with both a goal and an assist in HSV's important 3-1 win over Gladbach.

Although unable to find the net despite taking six shots, Kane impressed in a creative role, providing assists for both of Bayern's goals to take his Bundesliga assist tally to eight for the season.

One of the driving forces behind RB Leipzig's 5-2 win over Augsburg, Gruda provided two assists, created five chances and completed an impressive 10 of his 11 dribbles.

#2383. Behrami-Rocchi, discussione a Dazn. "Milan, livello top nel derby" - "No, l'Inter..."

Behrami-Rocchi, discussione a Dazn. "Milan, livello top nel derby" - "No, l'Inter..."

Scegli Fcinter1908.it come tuo sito preferito su Google: clicca qui

Botta e risposta a Dazn tra Gianluca Rocchi e Valon Behrami. Motivo della discussione è l'Inter vista nel derby.

Parte Gianluca Rocchi: "Quando tu (a Diletta Leotta, ndr) facesti la domanda se nel derby c'era stato più meriti Milan o demeriti Inter, lui ti rispose, secondo me giustamente, più Milan. La prima mezz'ora del Milan ma anche nel complesso la partita è stata veramente di livello"

Interviene Behrami: "No, non sono d'accordo, per me no. Nel derby ci vogliono altre componenti, è pura competizione. L'Inter non è disposta ad andare in quelle zone lì, a disperdere energie perché gestisce il campionato. Per me nel derby ci sono più demeriti Inter"

L'ex arbitro domanda: "Pensi che sia una questione d'approccio?"

Behrami risponde: "Nel derby il Milan era più stimolato, ci sono tanti nuovi, giovani, che vivono il derby in un'altra maniera. L'Inter non è disposta ad andarci in questo tipo di situazioni, col Como invece ho visto una squadra viva"

Napoli-Lazio 1-1: la capolista frena al Maradona, Frattesi non basta e Allegri evita l'esonero per un soffio

Al Maradona Napoli-Lazio finisce 1-1. Partita in cui i biancocelesti sono passati subito in vantaggio con la rete di Frattesi al 28’, ma i partenopei, con coraggio, l'hanno recuperata all’inizio della ripresa grazie all’autogol di Pedraza. I biancocelesti, a prescindere dal risultato dell’Inter, rimangono primi in classifica a quota 29 punti, mentre i padroni di casa salgono a 15 punti, agganciando il 10° posto. #2381. Équipe de France : Zidane appelle un joueur de deuxième division !

C'est la surprise majeure de ce rassemblement de novembre. Pour pallier le forfait sur blessure de Pierre Kalulu, le sélectionneur Zinédine Zidane a décidé d'appeler pour la première fois Saël Kumbedi en équipe de France ce lundi 9 novembre 2026. Une trajectoire fulgurante pour le latéral droit évoluant en deuxième division allemande.

Le premier jour du rassemblement à Clairefontaine a réservé un rebondissement de taille dans les rangs tricolores. En effet, Pierre Kalulu a dû déclarer forfait en raison d'une lésion aux ischios du membre inférieur gauche contractée ce week-end avec la Juventus. Face à ce coup dur dans le couloir droit, Zinédine Zidane s'est tourné vers Saël Kumbedi, alors que le joueur de 21 ans avait initialement été retenu par Gérald Baticle avec les Espoirs pour disputer deux rencontres amicales face à l'Italie à Brest et contre l'Angleterre à Bristol.

Comptant déjà neuf sélections avec les Bleuets, le défenseur franchit donc un cap décisif. Pour régler la pénurie à ce poste, le staff technique a délibérément privilégié la jeunesse du joueur de Wolfsburg plutôt que l'expérience de Jonathan Clauss, pourtant performant à Nice du haut de ses 34 ans et de ses quatorze sélections (2 buts). Un choix fort.

Avant d'atteindre le groupe de Zinédine Zidane, Saël Kumbedi a connu un parcours jalonné d'étapes intenses. Formé au Havre, le natif de Stains avait rejoint l'Olympique Lyonnais en 2022 contre un chèque d'un million d'euros, découvrant la Ligue 1 à seulement 17 ans sous la houlette de Peter Bosz avant d'enchaîner sous les ordres de Laurent Blanc. Au total, le défenseur a disputé 62 matches sous le maillot des Gones, dont quatre apparitions sur la scène européenne en Ligue Europa lors de l'exercice 2024-2025.

Prêté au VfL Wolfsburg à l'été 2025, le latéral a ensuite été transféré définitivement le 1er janvier 2026 pour un montant de six millions d'euros. Toutefois, l'institution allemande, championne de Bundesliga en 2009 et installée dans l'élite sans discontinuer depuis 1997, a été reléguée en mai 2026 lors d'un barrage contre Paderborn (0-0, 2-1 a.p.). Un coup dur pour la formation allemande. Resté fidèle au club en 2. Bundesliga, Kumbedi est rapidement devenu un titulaire indiscutable sous les ordres de Tobias Strobl, malgré une blessure musculaire lui ayant fait manquer trois matches.

Cette convocation inattendue concrétise la passerelle directe établie entre la sélection A et les moins de 21 ans tricolores. Présent chez les Espoirs, le défenseur Nathan Zézé avait d'ailleurs rapporté le discours tenu par Zinédine Zidane :

Le parcours de Saël Kumbedi en équipe de France démarre ainsi dans ce contexte de renouvellement. Les Bleus disputeront deux matches de Ligue des nations capitaux au cours de cette trêve internationale. Ils commenceront par un déplacement face à l'Italie à Milan, programmé le jeudi 12 novembre 2026 à 20h45. L'équipe de France recevra ensuite la Turquie à Bordeaux, le dimanche 15 novembre 2026 à 20h45.

#2380. Rashford returns and Fernandes misses another penalty as Man Utd humbled by Amorim

Bruno Fernandes missed a penalty for the second successive pre-season friendly as Manchester United were beaten 4-2 by former head coach Ruben Amorim’s AC Milan.

Fernandes, who rolled a spot-kick wide in a shoot-out against Leeds in midweek, was gifted the chance to open his pre-season account in Wroclaw, Poland.

His effort was on target this time, but Milan keeper Lorenzo Torriani dived to his right to beat the shot away.

Fernandes did at least get an assist, taking the second-minute corner which was powerfully headed home by Harry Maguire to give United the lead.

Amorim’s Milan equalised after a defensive mix-up allowed Gonçalo Ramos to break into the area and square for Samuel Chukwueze to roll home.

United were awarded their penalty just before half-time after Koni De Winter tugged back Youri Tielemans, but Torriani guessed correctly to leave Fernandes frustrated.

United retook the lead after Patrick Dorgu pounced on a loose backpass from Filippo Terracciano, but Milan equalised again when Chukwueze’s wayward shot was poked in by Alphadjo Cissè at the far post.

Marcus Rashford, who was frozen out by Amorim and loaned out to Aston Villa and then Barcelona, came on as a substitute on the hour for his first United appearance since returning from Spain.

But Milan went ahead in the 68th minute when Chukwueze’s cross was headed home by Ramos, and three minutes later former Chelsea midfielder Ruben Loftus-Cheek raced through to hit the fourth and cap a performance that underlines United’s need for reinforcements before their season starts in earnest next Saturday, away at Hull City.

Manchester United (4-2-3-1) Lammens; Mazraoui (Dalot 61), Maguire, Heaven (Martinez 61), Shaw; Tielemans, Santos (Mainoo 61); Diallo (Lacey 61), Fernandes, Dorgu (Rashford 61); Cunha (Mbeumo 61). Subs Zirkzee, Yoro, J Fletcher, T Fletcher, Amass, Collyer, Mee (g), Heath (g), Gabriel. Booked Dorgu.

AC Milan (3-4-2-1) Torriani; Terracciano (Gila 60), Winter (Vladimirov 84), Pavlovic (Diawara 84); Chukwueze, Musah (Ricci 76), Jashari (Modric 60), Estupinan (Bartesaghi 61); Loftus-Cheek (Comotto 84), Cisse (Saelemaekers 60); Ramos (Camarda 75). Subs Pittarella (g), Bouyer (g). Booked Estupinan.

Goals Chukwueze (37), Cisse (57), Ramos (68), Loftus-Cheek (71).

That six-time Champions League winner Luka Modric raised the trophy with the one hand said everything you need to know about this moment...

Aug 30: Manchester United vs Ipswich Town

Sep 13: Manchester United vs Manchester City

United’s pre-season ends in defeat. A wretched second half proves their undoing as Amorim’s Milan score four. Worth reminding that United led this match, twice.

Milan are playing keep-ball in these latter stages and although Mainoo regains possession, his attempt to play forward is cut out and Modric’s outside-of-the-foot pass finds Comotto, who heads straight at Lammens.

Four minutes of added time to be played...

United now raining crosses down on Milan’s box but Torriani equal to it every time.

For the second time this afternoon, Shaw directs a lovely ball into Fernandes’ path in behind Milan’s back line, but the Portugal international can’t bring it under his spell.

Martinez has added a little bit of urgency to United’s build-up. Mbeumo tries to feed Shaw down the line but the ball is cut out.

More substitutions... Diawara, Vladimirov and Comotto enter the field of play in place of Pavlovic, De Winter and Loftus-Cheek.

Big chance for Rashford! Martinez lofts a fantastic ball over the top but Rashford is not quite able to bring it under his spell, with Torriani and De Winter combing to clear their lines.

Milan are now sitting off, settling into a back five as they look to preserve their advantage. Fernandes, Tielemans and Dalot combine well but such has been United’s fortunes this afternoon, the ball ricochets off the referee and play is halted.

Good work from Rashford in the corner to regain possession, but his ball into the box is not picked up by a team-mate.

More changes... Ramos and Musah make way for Camarda and Ricci.

Manchester United 2 AC Milan 4 (Loftus-Cheek) No sooner had the players returned after the second-half hydration break then Milan exploit United’s exposed left side (again). Ramos sends Loftus-Cheek through and the midfielder composes himself before bending the ball around Lammens.

Manchester United 2 AC Milan 3 (Ramos) That’s too easy. United fail to learn their lesson, Shaw not getting tight enough to Chukwueze and the winger’s cross is met by new signing Ramos, who powers a header back across goal and past Lammens.

Loftus-Cheek and Ramos are doing a good job of cutting off the pass into United’s midfield in their build-up phase.

Rashford (who makes his first United appearance in almost two years), Lacey, Dalot, Mbeumo, Mainoo and Martinez replace Dorgu, Amad, Mazraoui, Cunha, Santos and Heaven.

For Milan, Saelemaekers, Bartesaghi, Gila and Modric are on for Cisse, Estupinan, Terracciano and Jashari

Manchester United 2 AC Milan 2 (Cisse) United have set a higher defensive line so far this half, with their front line pressing with more intensity to avoid the ball over the top. However Chukwueze is able to find space around the sides, coming in off the right and curling an effort goalwards which Cisse turns in at the far post. There are calls for offside, but with no VAR here, the goal stands.

Milan win a free-kick some 25 yards out after Fernandes clips Estupinan. Teenager Cisse steps up and fires straight into the United wall. Was always going to be difficult to trouble Lammens from there.

Manchester United 2 AC Milan 1 (Dorgu) United wisely decide to keep hold of the ball for a while, the midfield three rotating to disrupt Milan’s out-of-possession shape and open up passing lanes. A Milan throw-in from the right-back berth is precedes an awful backpass by Terracciano which is pounced on by Dorgu who curls the ball beyond Torriani.

United have looked bright in the opening moments of this half. They win a free-kick midway into Milan’s half. The ball is delivered to the back post and, after some 18-yard-box pinball, a relieved Torriano pounces on it.

Both teams remain unchanged as the second 45 minutes begin.

All square at the break. Tough to know what to make of that half – United looked solid enough and could have taken a lead into the interval had Fernandes converted his penalty, but they failed to create a wealth of clear-cut chances. It will be interesting to see how Carrick approaches this second half.

Milan have enjoyed just a tick over two-thirds of possession, which United have contributed to in part through some lackadaisical passing.

Fernandes misses a spot-kick for the second time in two friendlies! Here, Torriani guesses correctly, diving to his right to palm Fernandes’ strike away.

De Winter brings down Tielemans inside the box after Terracciano loses the ball attempting to play out from the back.

Manchester United 1 AC Milan 1 (Chukwueze) It’s all a bit messy. Jashari causes Maguire and Santos to crash into each other (Kaka at Old Trafford, anyone?) off a throw-in, Ramos taking over with the United pair out of commission. He finds Chukwueze who finishes the move off at the far post.

The match becomes stretched momentarily as Pavlovic, the centre-back, marauds forward, setting the ball to Estupinan who delivers another dangerous cross from the left, which Lammens does well to claim.

Santos clips Loftus-Cheek near the byline and the referee awards Milan a free-kick. Chukwueze cuts the ball back to an unmarked Jashari on the edge of the box, but his side-footed effort flies wide.

Milan supporters unfurl a banner paying tribute to the late, great Franco Baresi, who passed away on July 31 aged 66.

Hermosa bandera a Franco Baresi.QUE EN PAZ DESCANSE, LEYENDA DEL FÚTBOL 🙏🏻 pic.twitter.com/fvE48nKVSs

United have picked their moments to press. Santos, who has enjoyed a wonderful pre-season, is a little too overzealous in his attempts to regain possession and gives away a foul. But the intent is correct.

Shaw floats a delightful ball over the top for Fernandes to gallop on to. The Portuguese steals in ahead of De Winter but cannot find the target with his weaker left foot.

Cisse escapes the clutches of Mazraoui down the left and fires a shot (more likely a mis-hit cross) straight into the gloves of Lammens.

United finally get their foot on the ball, but Heaven attempts an ambitious cross-field pass and possession goes back to the Italians.

A Mexican wave has already begun. We’re only 21 minutes in...

Carrick’s side continue to sit off, allowing Milan to keep hold of the ball. Cisse works in from the left, playing a neat one-two with Ramos before his curled strike sails well over.

A period of extended possession for Milan, United dropping into a compact 4-4-2 mid-block. Estupinan rains in a dangerous cross from the left and the ball falls to Loftus-Cheek, whose effort is expertly saved by the right boot of Lammens.

Estupinan goes into the book after pulling Amad’s shirt as he looked to dart in behind after Tielemans had played a dangerous through-ball. Might possibly have been the last man?

Tielemans cedes possession to the busy Jashari just outside his own box, the Swiss midfielder moving the ball on to Loftus-Cheek who fires a shot straight at Lammens.

Amad picks Pavlovic’s pocket and the Milan centre-half is forced to concede a corner. United unable to score from this one.

Milan are indeed in Amorim’s preferred 3-4-2-1 formation. They circulate the ball in front of United’s first line of pressure in an attempt to calm things down.

Manchester United 1 AC Milan 0 (Maguire) Fernandes delivers an inswinger from the left and Maguire is there to meet it at the back post, striding past Musa to plant a header past Torriani.

United make a fast start, Dorgu flashing a cross-cum-shot across the face of goal. Torriani gets a fingertip to it and thte ball goes behind for a corner.

Szymon Marciniak, the experienced Polish referee, gets us under way. Milan send the ball back to goalkeeper Torriani.

The players emerge from the tunnel, United debuting their lovely new cream third kit and Milan in their traditional red-and-black home colours. Smoke machines and pyrotechnics add to the atmosphere in Wroclaw...

We are almost ready to go. Let us know your match predictions and thoughts on United’s prospects this season in the comments section beneath this blog.

Manchester United defeated Leeds United on penalties to hoist the mighty Boyle Sports Cup at Croke Park. The match, a 1-1 draw, was brought to an abrupt end after five young pitch invaders ran to the middle of the field to take selfies with Bruno Fernandes. In the shoot-out it was James Justin who missed the “decisive” spot-kick, paving the way for Noussair Mazraoui to win it for United.

Marcus Rashford is on the bench this afternoon and could make his first United appearance since his cameo in a Europa League win over Viktoria Plzen in December 2024. He was frozen out under Amorim and has since been loaned to Aston Villa and Barcelona, but his Old Trafford future under Carrick remains unclear.

Michael Carrick believes Manchester United can push for the Premier League title, but has underlined the urgent need for signings.

The United head coach has taken heart from his squad’s promising preparations for the new campaign and, speaking at their Co Kildare summer base, he explained why he was confident they could build on last season’s third-place finish.

Carrick has been thrilled to hear United’s players discussing what they might achieve and has dared supporters to dream that they can get closer to last year’s champions Arsenal. But he is also a realist and recognises he is not blessed with options.

So far United have added Youri Tielemans, Andrey Santos and Karl Darlow, a reserve goalkeeper, but their £83.3m spend is significantly less than what newly promoted clubs Ipswich Town (£109.4m) and Coventry City (£92.2m) have invested in their squads.

Amorim’s side have gone intercontinental this summer, travelling from Scotland to Indonesia, via Australia, before arriving in Poland for the last of their four pre-season games.

In memory of Franco Baresi 🇮🇹♾️ pic.twitter.com/ULAJRjxDvE

Manchester United Lammens; Mazraoui, Maguire, Heaven, Shaw; Tielemans, Santos, Fernandes; Amad, Dorgu; Cunha

Subs Heath, Mee, Amass, Dalot, Martínez, Yoro, Collyer, J. Fletcher, T. Fletcher, Mainoo, Gabriel, Lacey, Mbeumo, Rashford, Zirkzee

AC Milan Torriani; Terracciano, De Winter, Pavlović; Chukwueze, Jashari, Musah, Estupiñán; Loftus-Cheek, Cissè; Ramos

Subs Bouyer, Pittarella, Gila, Diawara, Vladimirov, Ricci, Saelemaekers, Bartesaghi, Modrić, Comotto, Camarda

At his AC Milan unveiling, Amorim was asked about the learnings from his United tenure that he would take into his new role. He said: “The first thing is it’s hard to explain the mistakes because for that I would have to explain the context of the last adventure.

“It’s hard to say to you every mistake. The only thing I can say is that I learned a lot and I made some mistakes.

“I didn’t have the opportunity, and I’m sorry for that, I didn’t have the opportunity to say something to the Manchester United fans at the moment and I’m really proud to be their coach for a year in that time.

“But now it’s a different history. There are a lot of things that I could do better in the last experience but sometimes it’s like that, you need to learn to find the right spot to reach a different level and that’s my thinking here.

“Everyone learns from their experience. I learned a lot, I did some mistakes I will try to change, there are some thing you will never change but I think I will be a better manager, that’s all.”

Aug 8: Paris St-Germain 1 Manchester United 1

Aug 12: Manchester United 1 Leeds United 1 (5-4 pens)

Gonçalo Ramos goes straight into Amorim’s starting XI after his switch from PSG.

Welcome to live coverage of Manchester United’s final pre-season match, against AC Milan in Wroclaw, Poland. Michael Carrick’s side will look to apply the finishing touches to a promising summer on the pitch, which has included victories over Rosenborg and Atlético Madrid, plus a draw against European champions Paris St-Germain. The team will fly back to Manchester with the big ones, the ones they have always wanted – the Snapdragon Cup and the Boyle Sports Cup – in tow.

At the Tarczynski Stadium there will be a reunion with former manager Ruben Amorim, who was appointed AC Milan’s head coach in June, five months after being sacked by United. Following a frustrating season under Massimiliano Allegri in which Milan fell out of the Champions League spots on the final day, the Rossoneri said Amorim would bring a “modern dominant tactical approach”. His methods failed to cut through at Old Trafford, though, during a tumultuous 14-month reign which finally ended after the Portuguese “blew up” during a heated meeting with director of football Jason Wilcox. At Milan, Amorim has persisted with the 3-4-2-1 formation that was doomed at United.

Carrick made clear this week that United must strengthen if they are to challenge for titles. So far the club have brought in Youri Tielemans, Andrey Santos and Karl Darlow, but they are still in the market for a left-back and another midfielder. The future of Marcus Rashford has also been a topic of conversation among United fans. The forward has not played for his boyhood club since December 2024 but has joined up with his team-mates in Poland and it remains to be seen if he features in Carrick’s forward planning.

Kobbie Mainoo, who did not play a minute at this summer’s World Cup, and Lisandro Martínez have also joined up with the team this week and could be handed their first minutes of pre-season having been named in the matchday squad. For Milan, new signing Gonçalo Ramos – bought from PSG for £63m – will make his first appearance in the famous red and black.

#2377. Lazzari nel post: "Punto preziosissimo. Gattuso? Ci ha ridato gioia e adrenalina"

Manuel Lazzari ha rilasciato delle dichiarazioni ai microfoni di LSC e Dazn poco dopo il fischio finale di Napoli-Lazio

Manuel Lazzari ha rilasciato delle dichiarazioni ai microfoni di LSC e Dazn poco dopo il fischio finale di Napoli-Lazio.

CLICCA QUI E SEGUI LAZIOPRESS.IT ANCHE SU INSTAGRAM

Questo punto ce lo prendiamo volentieri, è importantissimo perché abbiamo disputato un primo tempo importante e potevamo fare qualche gol in più. Nel secondo tempo il Napoli è cresciuto, sapevamo che venivamo in un campo difficile sapevamo che per loro era “l’ultima spiaggia” quindi ce lo prendiamo volentieri.

Abbiamo fatto un inizio di stagione incredibile, nessuno se lo aspettava e sin dal primo giorno il mister ci ha dato tante idee. Siamo cresciuti molto, è una gioia andare tutti i giorni a Formello ad allenarci. Dobbiamo seguire il mister e continuare così.

Il mister ha ridato gioia, adrenalina e un calcio completamente diverso rispetto allo scorso anno. Il gruppo lo ha seguito sin da subito, dopo 11 partite la risposta la squadra l’ha data e ora continuiamo così.

Penso che abbiamo approcciato alla partita in maniera meravigliosa, abbiamo fatto un grande primo tempo con diverse occasioni da gol e siamo riusciti a sbloccarla. Nel secondo tempo loro sono cresciuti, verso la metà della ripresa ci siamo equilibrati e a 10 minuti dalla fine volevamo tornare a casa con una vittoria ma venire a Napoli e sapere che per loro era l’ultima spiaggia, è un punto preziosissimo.

Questo punto ce lo prediamo alla grande perché 9 vittorie e 2 pareggi, nessuno se lo sarebbe aspettato a inizio stagione. Campo difficile, per loro era la gara della vita. Abbiamo fatto un grandissimo primo tempo, nel secondo loro sono cresciuti e poi da metà del secondo tempo diamo riusciti a riequilibrare la sfida. Punto veramente importante.

Il mister quest’anno è stato un fenomeno, ha portato allegria, gioia, voglia di essere protagonisti, di attaccare. Ha portato tante idee nuove e tutti i giocatori sia chi gioca che chi gioca meno è felice di allenasi oggi giorno. Il mister ha creato un gran gruppo, dobbiamo solo continuare a seguirlo.

Un grandissimo saluto ai tifosi, ieri è stato magnifico in stazione e speriamo di rivederli presto.

#2375. Man United eye Bayern assistant Aaron Danks as potential addition to Carrick’s backroom staff

Aaron Danks has recently underlined his importance to Vincent Kompany’s backroom staff, stepping in to take charge for five games during the 40-year-old Belgian coach's absence due to illness.

As reported by TEAMtalk, Danks has attracted interest from his home country, with Manchester United understood to be admirers of the Bayern Munich assistant.

Manchester United manager Michael Carrick is currently under pressure, but Danks is not being considered as a potential replacement for him.

Instead, United could look to bring Danks to Old Trafford to strengthen Carrick’s coaching staff should they decide to keep faith in their current manager, according to the report. The pair previously worked together at Middlesbrough.

Whether Danks would be interested in leaving Bayern at this stage, even if Man United were to show an interest, is highly questionable, though.

The 43-year-old joined Bayern from Middlesbrough in 2024 and remains under contract until 2029.

Una manifestazione di forza quella della squadra di Chivu che riscatta parzialmente la delusione di un derby giocato male e senza il piglio giusto. Come sottolinea la Gazzetta dello Sport, Thuram e Pio Esposito ieri si sono abbattuti come uragani sulla difesa lariana: un gol e una partecipazione a testa.

"Il francese, in particolare, migliore per distacco, è parso incontenibile. Roberto Mancini ne avrà preso atto con preoccupazione, visto che giovedì il Tikus tornerà a San Siro in veste di Galletto. Ma non solo loro. Tutti, da Bastoni a Barella, hanno riavvicinato i loro top di rendimento, dopo la brutta figura del derby. Passiamo l’evidenziatore su Dimarco, rifiorito di colpo: è entrato nei due gol e ha ritrovato la corsa selvaggia; e su Spence che, dopo mesi di complicato rodaggio, ieri si è preso San Siro per la prima volta. Bravo Chivu a raddrizzare subito la barca con due autorevoli vittorie ravvicinate. Si è regalato una sosta serena, a un passo dalla vetta".

"C’era una domanda che pendeva sul match: Como da scudetto? San Siro ha risposto: potrà diventarlo. Due campionati fa, dopo 11 giornate aveva 9 punti, l’anno scorso il doppio (18), ora 23".

Paolo Di Canio, dagli studi di Sky Sport, ha analizzato la vittoria dell'Inter contro il Como: "Lautaro se manca è un fattore, è un leader, anche al 60% soprattutto in certe partite ha la qualità tecnica per liberarsi, sa calciare come pochi... Però Thuram sta facendo la differenza: anche nelle ultime partite, quando l'Inter non produceva, lui si muoveva, si sbatteva, andava a cercare la palla, svariava su tutto il fronte d'attacco. È la squadra che cambia, e oggi abbiamo visto la vera Inter".

"La cosa buona dell'Inter è che ci sono degli anticorpi in società per cui non possono rovinare quello che si sono costruiti in questi 6 anni: assorbono quello che è il dettame della società, dell'ambiente serio. Si può perdere un attimo la retta via perchè ci siamo imborghesiti, perchè sembra tutto facile, ma quando non ti riescono più le cose? Non siamo più quelli?

Scegli FcInter1908 come tuo sito preferito su Google: clicca qui

Le prime 6 partite abbiamo parlato di dominio, di Inter ingiocabile, che è quello che penso io quando la vedo come oggi. Se si perdono, poi si ritrovano perchè c'è un ambiente sano e serio. Gli interventi di Akanji sono stati con una gamba tonica, e hanno giocato in settimana: è solo una questione di testa, al netto di qualche difetto che può avere come tante altre squadre".

"Queste freschezza, questa reattività, non è frutto di casualità, così come non era casualità quando prendeva gol. Quell'approccio era un difetto: lenti, compassati, di testa, nel giro palla, recuperi con i tempi sbagliati. Questa è l'Inter, che se ti aggredisce, ti viene a prendere, non è che le altre sono fenomenali a difendere. Il cambio di modulo contro il Milan mi è sembrata una scelta scriteriata, fai perdere identità alla squadra: succede anche ai migliori allenatori del mondo.

Scegli FcInter1908 come tuo sito preferito su Google: clicca qui

Diouf, un mancino, che è una mezz'ala dribblomane, che si mette a fare il quinto, disattento, che non ha il destro naturale... Spence? Gioca con una benda in Italia... con la benda gioca. Ma questo è stato titolare al Mondiale con la terza Nazionale del mondo. Non è che parliamo di uno... ha una gamba, una tecnica. La palla che dà, è un assist da Premier: palla violenta, o fai autogol o segna il mio compagno. Ma la capacità tecnica anche nell'uscita ce l'ha. Poi a volte si addormenterà perché è un po' così, ma se gli tolgono quel difetto sarà più facile che faccia lui il quinto con quell'atletismo, quella qualità e quella tecnica".

#2370. European Roundup: Maiden goals for Wirtz, Goretzka and Woltemade

Leon Goretzka and Nick Woltemade scored their first league goals for their new clubs, while Florian Wirtz ended his goal drought at Liverpool.

It took him until matchday 10, but Wirtz finally scored his first Premier League goal of the season in Liverpool's 3-1 win at bottom-placed Crystal Palace. The Germany international also set up ex-Borussia Dortmund striker Alexander Isak for the third goal as he already has the same number of assists (3) to his entire first season in England's top-flight.

Liverpool's win helped Manchester United to not further slip in the standings after their roller-coaster draw at home against Aston Villa. In a game three former Bayern players were on target, Noussair Mazraoui registered only his second assist in Manchester United colors.

The visitors led by a two-goal margin twice before having to settle for a draw. Nicolas Jackson continued his excellent form in front of goal, while Joshua Zirkzee got his first league goal of the season. Former Germany international Goretzka also scored his first-ever Premier League goal in his second start before Michael Carrick's side climbed to 18th place with two extra-time goals.

At the other end of the table, Fabian Hürzeler's Brighton are now up to second in the standings after Manchester City's third defeat in the row. Daniel Farke's Leeds United and Marco Rose's Bournemouth also prevailed before the break, while Matthias Jaissle's job is in danger at Newcastle United as they have only won once from the last six games in all competitions.

Newcastle United loanee Nick Woltemade is now in a good run of form for Juventus, despite Jürgen Klopp's snub for Germany's November games. The 24-year-old failed to score for the first time in Europe when his club returned home from Alkmaar with three points on Thursday, but he finally netted his first Serie A goal when the former giants had to settle for a hard-fought point in Florence.

Derby della Madonnina hero Christian Pulisic scored in each of his last three Serie A starts as the latest goal by the ex-BVB man helped AC Milan to a narrow win at in-form Genoa. Meanwhile, Inter recovered immediately as Marcus Thuram's goal in the 2-0 win over Como helped him reach 50 goals in domestic competitions since leaving Borussia Mönchengladbach on a free transfer.

Former Bundesliga center-backs Arthur Theate and Mario Hermoso were also on target in matchday 11 Serie A action for Bologna and AS Roma, respectively.

Marc Bartra is another ex-Bundesliga center-half to score this weekend after he was an unused substitute in his return to Westfalenstadion. The 35-year-old found the net in back-to-back league games for LaLiga outfit Real Betis for the first time since December 2019.

After a difficult season in England with Everton, Adam Aznou is trying to find his feet in Spain with Malaga, where he joined on an initial loan deal. However, he will now face more time on the sidelines after his red card in their 2-1 defeat to fellow newly-promoted side Racing Santander.

Saturday's clash was the first time the former FC Bayern youngster started a home league game since leaving the Rekordmeister on bad terms. Elsewhere in LaLiga, former Augsburg attacker Ruben Vargas missed a first-half penalty-kick in Sevilla’s goalless draw with out-of-form Alaves.

Yan Diomandè’s Real Madrid are now in second place in Spanish's top-flight after Barcelona ended Atlético Madrid's seven-game winning streak as Hansi Flick's men extend their lead at the top. In France, PSG head into the break with 11 successive wins in all competitions.

Paris Brunner's AS Monaco are now dropped to seventh place as a 1-1 draw at newcomers Le Mans extended their winless run to five games. Nice and Brest continued their good forms as Jonathan Clauss and Ludovic Ajourque continued their scoring run. Gio Reyna reached three league goals for the first time since the 2022/23 season, although Strasbourg have lost five of their last six Ligue 1 encounters.

Reyna's ex-teammate Julian Brandt missed Ajax's last two games due to an injury. The record Eredivisie winners had a chance to climb to the top of the table after Feyenoord's 5-3 defeat at Heerenveen. However, they squandered a two-goal lead against Twente as former Wolfsburg and Hoffenheim striker Wout Weghorst beat Germany's number one Marc-André ter Stegen with a 95th-minute penalty-kick.

The top five teams in Eredivisie are only separated by three points as Peter Bosz's PSV are now back in top place following a 5-2 win at newcomers Cambuur.

Thomas Reis’ winning streak at Trabzonspor ended on Thursday by SC Freiburg, but he still has a perfect record in Süper Lig as Mohamed Salah's goal helped his side to climb past Amedspor in second place. Hoffenheim loanee Gift Orban has scored more goals than compatriot Victor Osimhen and Salah, but the debutants dropped to third after a 4-3 defeat at league leaders Galatasaray.

Meanwhile, Bayer Leverkusen loanee Ernest Poku scored his first league goal for Beşiktaş. Former Germany youth international Davie Selke was also on target on matchday 11 of Turkish top-flight for İstanbul Başakşehir.

Ex-Ingolstadt man Dennis Eckert scored a hat-trick for St. Liege to help the former giants beat Beveren in Belgian Pro League. RB Salzburg extended their winning streak in Austrian Bundesliga to four games with a 4-3 victory over Sturm Graz as Haris Tabaković, Leandro Morgalla and Jesper Lindstrøm were all on target.

Former VfB Stuttgart and Hertha BSC midfielder Santiago Ascacibar won the revamped Argentine Campeón de Liga in a dramatic manner with Boca Juniors. The giants squeezed past Rosario Central with Enner Valencia’s 96th-minute winner against Defensa y Justicia.

Il mister Gennaro Gattuso ha rilasciato delle dichiarazioni ai microfoni di Dazn poco dopo il fischio finale di Napoli-Lazio

Il mister Gennaro Gattuso ha rilasciato delle dichiarazioni ai microfoni di Dazn poco dopo il fischio finale di Napoli-Lazio.

CLICCA QUI E SEGUI LAZIOPRESS.IT ANCHE SU INSTAGRAM

Campo difficile, squadra forte. Oggi sono andato nello spogliatoio e c'era un mortorio. Abbiamo fatto un grande primo tempo, mentre nel secondo, nella prima parte, ci hanno schiacciato, ma ci stava. Mi piace che la squadra oggi sia delusa. Siamo orgogliosi di questi ragazzi. Venire qui in un momento del genere non è mai facile, dobbiamo essere soddisfatti. Voglio vedere più sorrisi, per me la prestazione c'è stata anche oggi.

Frattesi? È un capoccione, diventa pazzo. Si sente fuori dalla partita, vuole toccre. In Europa ce ne sono pochi invasori come lui. Lavoriamo sui picchi di velocità per fare cose di questo tipo. Lui dovrebbe farne di più, ma lui si fissa che vuole toccare. Oggi anche nel primo tempo, con queste rotture, corse nello spazio, potevamo fare qualche gol in più. Ci teniamo la prestazione, sono soddisfatto.

Noslin ha dato garanzie anche a sinistra? Sì, molto. È veemente, quando va in pressione va sempre con grande veemenza. Sta bene fisicamente, mi è piaciuto anche in quella posizione lì. È diventato più ordinato rispetto a quest'estate durante le amichevoli.

Classifica? Non dobbiamo vederla. Adesso recuperiamo, hanno tre giorni liberi, giovedì ripartiamo forte. Bisogna mettere benzina, non guardare nulla. C'entriamo poco lì, dobbiamo vivere alla giornata. Anche oggi abbiamo avuto coraggio, abbiamo sofferto, sapevamo che ci avrebbero messo in difficoltà. L'abbiamo accettato, e questa è mentalità. Questi ragionamenti si devono fare nelle ultime 6-7 partite, adesso bisogna mettere fieno in cascina.
